title: Lawn Care Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care equipment inspection report for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified lawn-care technician or applicator must inspect turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Lawn Care inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Property and treatment boundaries confirmed before work
People, children, pets, vehicles, and movable property cleared or protected
Hidden utilities, irrigation heads, drainage features, and obstacles identified
Slope, wet ground, traffic, heat, lightning, and other weather hazards assessed
Mower guards, discharge controls, blades, and service equipment inspected
Product label, applicator qualification, PPE, and application conditions verified
Water, wells, storm drains, pollinator areas, and neighboring property protected
Mowing height, route, clipping, pruning, and treatment instructions defined
Gate, key, alarm, and access controls preserved
Reentry, watering, cleanup, and follow-up instructions assigned

sections.guidance: Separate the immediate protection from the corrective action and from the final serviceability decision.

Slope, wet ground, drop-off, heat, storm, or lightning condition unsafe
Equipment guard, blade, tire, control, or emergency stop is defective
Product label, qualification, PPE, weather, or application boundary not met

Tree, branch, retaining wall, sinkhole, or structural condition appears unstable

Work would conflict with irrigation, construction, occupants, or another vendor

sections.title: Lawn Care inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Base the stated status on explicit findings, test limits, defect control, and qualified authorization.

blocks.label: Release and condition verification points
items: All authorized zones received the documented service
Mowing, edging, trimming, and cleanup meet the approved standard
No visible discharge, debris, or damage remains on hardscape or property
Applied product and rate agree with the label and service record
Gates, irrigation controls, furniture, and movable items are restored
People, pets, water, and sensitive areas remain protected
Known plant, turf, drainage, or equipment concerns are documented
Customer received watering, reentry, and next-visit instructions

sections.title: Lawn Care equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This lawn care equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when weather, chemical labeling, people or pets, hidden utilities, slope, equipment guarding, property boundary, or treatment condition is uncertain. A turf, pesticide, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
